final: WITH purpose_avgs AS (SELECT k_symbol, AVG(amount) AS avg_amount FROM "order" WHERE amount >= 2802 GROUP BY k_symbol), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS overall_avg FROM purpose_avgs) SELECT p.k_symbol, p.avg_amount, p.avg_amount - o.overall_avg AS excess FROM purpose_avgs p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.avg_amount > o.overall_avg ORDER BY p.k_symbol
